description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Arachne, adding one mana of the appropriate color to cast Spider-Man.
Cast Spider-Man for its web-slinging cost, paying one mana and returning Arachne to your hand.
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Spider-Man, adding one mana of the appropriate color to cast Arachne.
Cast Arachne for its web-slinging cost by paying one mana and returning Spider-Man to your hand.
Repeat.
